status: pre-registered after the smoke, before the full run
question: Gemini 4's Pre-WDD: can the upstream MLP rows that feed a known attribute neuron be named from the weights alone (the target's norm-folded read vector against every upstream write column and the token embeddings), and does negating them, the target untouched, move the attribute as well as the data-driven feeders do?
design: Qwen2.5-0.5B; targets = the top row of the direct-contribution scan per attribute (gender block 4 row 3019, number block 7 row 870); data-free nominees: |cos| of each upstream write column (blocks below the target) with the target's up read vector times the RMSNorm gain (Gemini's one-line baseline), the raw dot product, |cos| with the gate read vector, OMP (k=32) on the up read vector; data-driven references: the pole activation change times the virtual weight, signed toward the target's marked-pole drive, through the up and through the gate; random rows of the same blocks; the target itself. Held-out flips, the target's held-out activation, wikitext KL (12 windows).
note: The smoke uses the full item set, so its k = 8 numbers, the selectivity percentiles, the correlations and the embedding AUCs are already final and are recorded here as observed, not tested. Only what the smoke did not compute is pre-registered: k = 32 and three random draws.

hypotheses.H1: Gemini's one-line baseline at k = 32: negating the top 32 upstream rows by |cos| with the target's up read vector, the target untouched, flips at least half as many held-out marked items as the data-driven top 32 through the up path, on both targets
hypotheses.H2: the gate read vector at k = 32: the top 32 by |cos| with the gate read vector flip at least half as many held-out marked items as the data-driven top 32 through the gate, on both targets
hypotheses.H3: above random at k = 32: each data-free nominee set (up cos, raw, gate cos, OMP) flips at least 0.1 more held-out marked items than the mean of three random draws of 32 upstream rows, on both targets
hypotheses.H4: OMP adds nothing at k = 32: OMP's flips are within 0.05 of the one-line up |cos| nominees' or below, on both targets
